name: Code Review Workflow
description: Review the ticket's pull request in a session of its own: is every piece needed, is it correct, clean, simple, performant and secure, and does it match the designs. Reads the code before the designs, posts inline comments with a severity and a concrete fix, answers every open thread, fixes what is clear on the same branch and posts one summary comment.

stages.name: Check security, performance, tests and prose
